name: Manager switches between the cockpit and the own flat
title: SC-06-04-05 Manager switches between the cockpit and the own flat
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the manager cockpit is shown with 3 navigation tabs
When the manager switches to the own flat and back
Then the own flat shows 2 navigation tabs and the cockpit shows 3 again
